detail.longDescription: Renamed a pile of files in Windows Explorer and want the old names back? Press Ctrl+Z in Explorer right away (or right-click → Undo Rename). Microsoft's PowerRename docs say it can undo the last change. The catch: do it before anything else in that folder, and stop touching that folder until you've tried. More: https:// tidybatch.github.io/guides/und o-bulk-rename/?utm_source=mastodon # Windows # FileManagement # Productivity (Written with AI help.)
